description.value: Firing from stealth doesn't automatically reveal your position; creatures get a -2 to Seek checks trying to pinpoint you by sound alone.

cinderfall.incomplete: "Creatures get a -2 to Seek checks trying to pinpoint you by sound alone" has no rule-element equivalent: pf2e rule elements on a held item modify the wielder's own rolls, not other creatures' checks made against the wielder, and no selector exists for 'an enemy's Seek check targeting the item-holder' specifically. Real pf2e's own Silencer (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/equipment/silencer.json) describes the identical fiction ('only makes a quiet noise when fired') but deliberately states no number and carries rules: [] -- this card chose to commit to a concrete -2, which is the part that can't be automated.
